dismissDescription: You can add assets and connect banks later; the empty screens show the next step.
welcomeTitle: Your portfolio and your spending, <accent>for real</accent>.
welcomeLeadQuestions: Vera answers two questions: is the money you invested split the way you want? And where does the money you spend every month go?
welcomeLeadOptional: The setup has two steps. Both are optional: you can skip either one and do it later.
pathAssetsDescription: To see how your portfolio is split, compare it with your target and know where to invest next.
pathBanksDescription: So your spending arrives on its own, categorized, with suggestions on where to cut.
assetsStepDescription: Tell us what you own and where. Vera adds it all up, in reais or dollars, and compares it with the portfolio you consider ideal.
banksStepDescription: With your banks connected, every card and account expense reaches Vera on its own. You type nothing.
doneLeadReady: See what is already set up. Whatever was left for later can be done at any time.
doneLeadStart: You skipped both steps, no problem. Vera shows you where to start whenever you want.
summaryErrorDetail: You can still go to the dashboard.
assetsDoneDetail: The distribution and the comparison with your target are already in the Overview.
assetsPendingDetail: Add them whenever you want in "My assets".
banksDoneDetail: Your spending shows up in the monthly summary.
banksPendingDetail: Connect whenever you want in "Connections" or import a statement.
targetTitle: Moderate target portfolio as a starting point
targetDetail: An initial split to compare against. Adjust it to your view in "Target portfolio".
loadErrorTitle: Could not load the initial setup.
loadErrorDetail: Check your connection and try again.
errorGeneric: Could not finish right now. Please try again in a moment.
errorAlreadyClosed: The initial setup has already been closed.
errorSampleUnavailable: Sample data is not available right now.
errorSampleFailed: Could not load the sample data. Nothing was changed.
errorTooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
assetsWhy1Detail: Brazil, US and crypto in a single currency, split by type: fixed income, stocks, REITs, crypto.
assetsWhy2Detail: E.g. "you hold 18% in US stocks and wanted 25%". Without knowing what you own, there is nothing to compare.
assetsWhy3Detail: Smart contribution splits each new deposit to bring the portfolio closer to the target, without selling anything.
assetsNoteText: There is no free, reliable way to pull positions from every broker, foreign bank and exchange. You only enter the quantity; values update on their own every day from market quotes or the index.
assetsCardDetail: Pick an investment type. Start with the biggest ones; you can finish later in "My assets".
assetsComingSoonDetail: For now you can skip this step and add your assets later, in "My assets".
banksWhy1Detail: Credit card and checking account, updated every day, no spreadsheet.
banksWhy2Detail: Groceries, delivery, transport and subscriptions are recognized. You only teach what is new, once.
banksWhy3Detail: With the history, Vera compares each category with your average and shows where to save to reach your goal.
banksNoteText: Open Finance only hands data to institutions authorized by the Central Bank. Meu Pluggy is the free bridge: you connect your banks there and authorize reading. Your bank password never goes through Vera, and access is read-only.
banksCardDetail: About 15 minutes, one time only. The detailed walkthrough is always available in "Connections".
pluggyStep1: Create your account and connect your banks at <meu/>.
pluggyStep2: Create the developer account at <dashboard/> and an application with the MeuPluggy connector.
pluggyStep3: In the application Demo, authorize Meu Pluggy once per bank and copy each <kbd>Item ID</kbd>.
pluggyStep4: On the Connections screen, paste the <kbd>Client ID</kbd>, the <kbd>Client Secret</kbd> and the Item IDs.
pluggyTrialWarning: Creating the account on the Pluggy dashboard starts the 15-day trial. Connect all your banks within that period.
importAction: Import a statement from your bank (OFX or CSV).
banksConnectedDetail: Your expenses from the last months are already arriving.
